title: Incorrect line number passed to External Editor Exec Flags when clicking on GDScript parse errors in EditorLog
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in: 4.6.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable (001aa128b) - macOS Sonoma (14.8.4) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (16 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

When clicking on the file/line link of a `Parse Error` line in the log, the external editor ends up on line 1, not the actual line that the error occurred on.  The functionality was added in #111805.

What's happening behind the scenes is that `ScriptEditorPlugin::open_in_external_editor()` is being called twice for the single click.  The first time it has the correct line number.  The second call it has line number -1.  I've verified the external editor gets both calls, the first one it opens the file and moves the cursor to the proper line, the second call moves the cursor to line 1.

```txt
    frame #1: 0x0000000103b550c4 godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64`ScriptEditor::edit(this=0x000000035db08a10, p_resource=0x000000016fdfa170, p_line=-1, p_col=0, p_grab_focus=true) at script_editor_plugin.cpp:2601:7
    frame #2: 0x0000000103b5a460 godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64`ScriptEditor::edit(this=0x000000035db08a10, p_resource=0x000000016fdfa170, p_grab_focus=true) at script_editor_plugin.h:585:95

    frame #4: 0x0000000102b8cbf4 godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64`EditorNode::_edit_current(this=0x0000000123161a10, p_skip_foreign=false, p_skip_inspector_update=false) at editor_node.cpp:3218:19
    frame #5: 0x0000000102b78ecc godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64`EditorNode::push_item(this=0x0000000123161a10, p_object=0x000000012c03d810, p_property=0x000000016fdfaa88, p_inspector_only=false) at editor_node.cpp:2949:2
    frame #6: 0x0000000102ffe1ac godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64`InspectorDock::_resource_selected(this=0x000000017759a410, p_res=0x000000016fdfab60, p_property=0x0
00000016fdfaa88) at inspector_dock.cpp:398:31
    frame #7: 0x0000000103000db0 godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64`InspectorDock::edit_resource(this=0x000000017759a410, p_resource=0x000000016fdfab60) at inspector_dock.cpp:519:2
    frame #8: 0x0000000102b57704 godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64`EditorLog::_meta_clicked(this=0x0000000177736010, p_meta=0x000000016fdfabf8) at editor_log.cpp:217:36
```

It looks like the issue is that `InspectorDock::edit_resource()` is opening the file a second time, without any knowledge about the line number:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ee713ccb7cbaddf59f8258ed6663461779d00856/editor/editor_log.cpp#L219-L223


### Steps to reproduce

* Set up an external editor, that uses the `{line}` in the Exec Flags
* Verify that the external editor flags work properly for jumping to a line
* Create any GDScript file with a syntax error anywhere after the first line
* Click on the Parser error in the EditorLog
* Note that you end up on line 1, not the line of the actual error

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

It's all in editor settings, so MRP wouldn't work.
